points.point: Battle card 的競品比較本質是 sales positioning，不是可引用的技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: says use formal specs/docs rather than sales positioning

points.point: 對競品的主張只有 R&S 內部 battle card 單一來源，對外使用前須補競品官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: partial
points.why: states this for Keysight, but not all competitors

points.point: battle card 數字不可當作 binding specifications，引用時只能標示為特定日期的 sales claim，並等待正式規格文件
points.label: partial
points.why: notes nonbinding/sales language, but not dated sales-claim labeling or battle-card numbers

points.point: AI 相關的 R&S 自動化工具（AI Script Assistant / CONTEST）在 battle card 中未提供文件版次，Keysight toolchain 需官方資料
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions AI Script Assistant/Atlas needing versions, but omits CONTEST and full official-toolchain evidence

points.point: CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 的能力只有 PR 說法，缺 benchmark、correctness metric、coverage matrix 與驗證條件
points.label: partial
points.why: says AI sources need versions/boundaries, but omits missing benchmark/correctness/coverage/validation details

points.point: non-signaling / production 平台的能力主張，必須分別引用各平台的正式 source page
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state each non-signaling/production platform needs its own official source page

points.point: 競品官方 brochure 可用於描述競品，但不可用來驗證 R&S 自家的優勢主張
points.label: missing
points.why: does not say competitor brochures cannot validate R&S advantage claims

points.point: AI-assisted 測試工作流的價值需用可量測指標衡量，而 PR 語言未提供量化 benchmark 或驗證方法
points.label: partial
points.why: implies verifiable evidence/test conditions, but lacks measurable AI workflow metrics and benchmark-method requirement
